native.scope: Single-worker Lambert diagnostic; warm/uncontrolled caches, CPU reference retained; no production speedup claim
native.timing_notes: Wall spans may overlap across threads. Device total includes initialization and validation. Collect includes its wait. Validation includes binary-record I/O. Diagnostic I/O aggregates logging on both threads. Queue residence is summed per request, not critical-path time. GPU event interval overlaps host wait/launch. Do not sum all fields.

guards.scope: Standalone guard checks; native rendering is validated separately
